svg.aria-label: Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 3090, ashalliants/ninfer-3090 against the best published figures. Chat, one request, vs syv-ai HyperQwen: 1.02x decode (133.2 vs 131.2), 1.22x prefill. Code vs open-jet: 1.39x (194.6 vs 140). No drafts vs open-jet: 1.11x (47.7 vs 42.9). 98K-token context vs open-jet: 0.98x (93.9 vs 95.9). Eight requests at once vs syv-ai: 1.03x (421.4 vs 407.3).

svg.text: Qwen3.8-27B on one RTX 3090: against the best published figures
ashalliants/ninfer-3090 against the fastest figure any other engine publishes for this model on one RTX 3090, per
workload. Above 1.0x means ours is faster. Every other figure is the author's own, from a different machine, quant
and power limit, so read the ratios as indicative.

svg.text: tokens per second, higher is better
Server-side prefill time of one fresh prompt, no prefix reused. The 10K report does not name its engine (probably syv-ai's).
Where we lose: at 98K tokens of context open-jet reports 95.9 tok/s against our 93.9 (0.98x). syv-ai's batch mode reports about 1,035
tok/s at 64 requests; NInfer is built for one to eight.
Quants differ: ours is this fork's Q4/Q5 group-quant mix (17.0 GiB), syv-ai runs W4A16 AutoRound with int8 Marlin layers, open-jet
